name: root
description: A monorepo of Vue and React packages for Cosmos SDK apps
author: Tendermint, Inc <hello@ignite.com>

scripts.alpha: lerna publish --force-publish --canary --preid alpha-$(git rev-parse HEAD) --dist-tag alpha --yes --no-verify-access
scripts.prepatchrel: node patch.cjs && git add ./packages/vue-template/package.json && git commit -m 'chore(release): Bumped @ignt/vue-lib version in template' && lerna version patch --yes -m 'chore(release): publish %s'
scripts.preminor: node minor.cjs && git add ./packages/vue-template/package.json && git commit -m 'chore(release): Bumped @ignt/vue-lib version in template' && lerna version minor --yes -m 'chore(release): publish %s'
scripts.premajor: node major.cjs && git add ./packages/vue-template/package.json && git commit -m 'chore(release): Bumped @ignt/vue-lib version in template' && lerna version major --yes -m 'chore(release): publish %s'
